name: session-overview
description: Keeps a per-turn log of a long-running session and shows where it stands: goal, progress, whether it is on track, decisions and open questions.

logModel.title: Log model
logModel.description: Writes each turn's note and rebuilds the overview.

chatModel.title: Chat model
chatModel.description: Answers questions in the overview pane from the notes. The pane can switch it for the rest of the session.

transcriptModel.title: Transcript model
transcriptModel.description: Answers questions in the overview pane from a trimmed copy of the conversation. The pane can switch it for the rest of the session.
